description: This file defines an abstract class 'ShapeRenderer' responsible for rendering shape objects within a PDF rendering context using the PdfSharp library. It manages layout, formatting, and drawing of shapes like lines and fills, supporting different positioning and alignment options.

classes.name: ShapeRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for rendering shape objects within a PDF document, managing layout, formatting, and drawing.

methods.name: InitialLayoutInfo
methods.description: Calculates and returns the initial layout information for the shape, including margins and references.

methods.name: GetFloating
methods.description: Determines the floating behavior of the shape based on its wrap style and relative vertical positioning.

methods.name: ShapeWidth
methods.description: Returns the total width of the shape including the line width.

methods.name: ShapeHeight
methods.description: Returns the total height of the shape including the line width.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the shape within a given area, adjusting layout based on whether the shape fits.

methods.name: FinishLayoutInfo
methods.description: Finalizes and sets detailed layout information for the shape, such as content area, margins, alignment, and positioning.

methods.name: GetHorizontalReference
methods.description: Returns the horizontal reference point for the shape relative to the page or area boundary.

methods.name: GetVerticalReference
methods.description: Returns the vertical reference point for the shape relative to the page or previous element.

methods.name: GetVerticalAlignment
methods.description: Determines vertical alignment of the shape based on its top position.

methods.name: RenderFilling
methods.description: Renders the fill color or pattern within the shape.

methods.name: RenderLine
methods.description: Renders the border line of the shape.

methods.name: GetHorizontalAlignment
methods.description: Determines the shape's horizontal alignment based on its left position.
